properties.description:
Review this complete iteration inside Broccoli, across TheBroccoli, BtrTemplate and PersoTemplate. Read the attached review guide, independent architecture findings, reference evidence and test results. Accepted reference reservations override image-generation noise.

Walk through Inputs / Active / Closed, truthful typed node editing and invariants, composable search, long persistent chat and Pi configuration, global annotations and immutable candidate Preview. The separate Ergonomics playground is an ordinary multi-repository buildspace with disposable populated data.

Success requires the user's in-app review and ability to bootstrap subsequent work through Broccoli. Automated checks and implementation status do not constitute human acceptance. A live provider smoke test still needs the user's compatible API key. No actual recurring jobs are enabled by delivery. Review comments, candidate iteration and eventual approval/commit remain in Broccoli; the implementing agent does not approve or commit these changes.

## Consolidated serial plan
This review now captures the complete earlier implementation group through its containing demonstration task, including every original implementation record and its evidence. Its required reviewer, mandatory checks and prior run evidence are retained. It remains a separate approval gate before the sign-in/editor verification group. Earlier immutable candidates remain available by revision; the revised candidate does not inherit approval or fresh check status.
